 local launcher=New("TextButton",{BackgroundTransparency=.12,BorderSizePixel=0,Position=UDim2.new(0,20,.5,-28),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(56,56),Text="",Visible=true,ZIndex=30,Parent=g});bind(launcher,"BackgroundColor3","Panel");shellGlass(launcher);Round(launcher,999);bind(Stroke(launcher,T.A1,.4),"Color","A1");New("ImageLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(7,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(42,42),Image=LOGO,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,ZIndex=31,Parent=launcher})

 local launcherPointerDown=false
 local launcherDragStart=nil
 local launcherDragged=false

 launcher.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
   or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
   launcherPointerDown=true
   launcherDragged=false
   launcherDragStart=input.Position
  end
 end)

 X.Connections[#X.Connections+1]=UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
  if launcherPointerDown and launcherDragStart
   and (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
   if (input.Position-launcherDragStart).Magnitude>=7 then
    launcherDragged=true
   end
  end
 end)

 X.Connections[#X.Connections+1]=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
  if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
   or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
   launcherPointerDown=false
   launcherDragStart=nil
  end
 end)

 function X:IsOpen()
  return main.Visible
 end

 function X:Minimize()
  X:CloseActivePopup()
  main.Visible=false
  launcher.Visible=true
 end

 function X:Restore()
  launcher.Visible=true
  main.Visible=true
 end

 function X:ToggleVisibility()
  if X:IsOpen() then
   X:Minimize()
  else
   X:Restore()
  end
 end

 launcher.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  if launcherDragged then
   launcherDragged=false
   return
  end

  X:ToggleVisibility()
 end)

 local function searchNormalize(v)return string.lower(tostring(v or"")):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")end
 local function searchTarget(target)
  if typeof(target)=="Instance"then return target end
  if type(target)=="table"then if target.Primary~=nil or target.Fallback~=nil then return searchTarget(target.Primary)or searchTarget(target.Fallback)end;return target.Row or target.Frame or target.Button or target.Content or target._Row or target._Frame end
 end

 function X:FocusSearchTarget(target)
  local object=searchTarget(target)
  if not object or not object.Parent or not object:IsA("GuiObject")then return end
  local scroller=object.Parent
  while scroller and scroller~=main and not scroller:IsA("ScrollingFrame")do scroller=scroller.Parent end
  if scroller and scroller:IsA("ScrollingFrame")then
   local y=object.AbsolutePosition.Y-scroller.AbsolutePosition.Y+scroller.CanvasPosition.Y-8
   scroller.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(scroller.CanvasPosition.X,math.max(0,y))
  end
  local old=object:FindFirstChild("SerenitySearchFocus")if old then old:Destroy()end
  local focus=New("UIStroke",{Name="SerenitySearchFocus",Color=T.A2,Transparency=.04,Thickness=2,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,Parent=object})
  task.delay(1.25,function()if focus.Parent then Tw(focus,.22,{Transparency=1}).Completed:Wait();focus:Destroy()end end)
 end

 local function clearSearch()
  for _,child in ipairs(searchResults:GetChildren())do if child:IsA("GuiButton")then child:Destroy()end end
 end

 local function searchScore(entry,query)
  if query==""then return entry.Kind=="Page"and 30 or entry.Kind=="Feature"and 20 or 10 end
  local title=searchNormalize(entry.Title);local feature=searchNormalize(entry.Feature);local page=searchNormalize(entry.Page);local description=searchNormalize(entry.Description);local kind=searchNormalize(entry.Kind);local score=0
  if title==query then score+=140 elseif string.sub(title,1,#query)==query then score+=105 elseif string.find(title,query,1,true)then score+=80 end
  if string.find(feature,query,1,true)then score+=48 end;if string.find(page,query,1,true)then score+=36 end;if string.find(description,query,1,true)then score+=24 end;if string.find(kind,query,1,true)then score+=12 end
  local haystack=table.concat({title,feature,page,description,kind}," ")
  for token in string.gmatch(query,"%S+")do if not string.find(haystack,token,1,true)then return 0 end;score+=4 end
  return score
 end

 local function renderSearch()
  clearSearch();local query=searchNormalize(searchBox.Text);local matches={}
  for _,entry in ipairs(X.SearchEntries)do local score=searchScore(entry,query)if score>0 then matches[#matches+1]={Entry=entry,Score=score}end end
  table.sort(matches,function(a,b)if a.Score==b.Score then return tostring(a.Entry.Title)<tostring(b.Entry.Title)end return a.Score>b.Score end)
  local shown=math.min(#matches,16);searchStatus.Text=query==""and("Browse %d searchable items or start typing."):format(#matches)or("%d result%s"):format(#matches,#matches==1 and""or"s")
  if shown==0 then searchStatus.Text="No matching page, feature, or setting.";return end
  for index=1,shown do
   local entry=matches[index].Entry
   local result=New("TextButton",{LayoutOrder=index,AutoButtonColor=false,BackgroundTransparency=.38,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.new(1,-3,0,46),Text="",ZIndex=42,Parent=searchResults});bind(result,"BackgroundColor3","Panel2");Round(result,8);local rs=Stroke(result,T.Stroke,.76);bind(rs,"Color","Stroke")
   local rt=New("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,18),Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Text=tostring(entry.Title or"Untitled"),TextSize=10,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=43,Parent=result});bind(rt,"TextColor3","Text")
   local trail={}if entry.Page then trail[#trail+1]=entry.Page end;if entry.Feature and entry.Feature~=entry.Title then trail[#trail+1]=entry.Feature end;trail[#trail+1]=entry.Kind or"Item"
   local rb=New("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,23),Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,14),Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,Text=table.concat(trail,"  >  "),TextSize=8,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=43,Parent=result});bind(rb,"TextColor3","Dim")
   result.MouseEnter:Connect(function()Tw(result,.09,{BackgroundTransparency=.20});Tw(rs,.09,{Transparency=.40})end);result.MouseLeave:Connect(function()Tw(result,.09,{BackgroundTransparency=.38});Tw(rs,.09,{Transparency=.76})end)
   result.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()X:CloseSearch();if type(entry.Activate)=="function"then entry.Activate()end end)
  end
 end

 -- POPUP / OUTSIDE-CLICK MANAGER --------------------------------------
 -- Select and MultiSelect use one shared popup manager.
 -- Only one menu can be open at a time.
 -- Clicking/tapping anywhere outside the active selector/menu closes it.
 local function pointInside(guiObject,position)
  if not guiObject or not guiObject.Parent or not guiObject.Visible then
   return false
  end

  local pos=guiObject.AbsolutePosition
  local size=guiObject.AbsoluteSize

  return position.X>=pos.X
   and position.X<=pos.X+size.X
   and position.Y>=pos.Y
   and position.Y<=pos.Y+size.Y
 end

 function X:ActivatePopup(item)
  if X.ActivePopup and X.ActivePopup~=item then
   pcall(function()
    X.ActivePopup:Close(true)
   end)
  end

  X.ActivePopup=item
 end

 function X:DeactivatePopup(item)
  if X.ActivePopup==item then
   X.ActivePopup=nil
  end
 end

 function X:CloseActivePopup()
  local active=X.ActivePopup

  if active then
   pcall(function()
    active:Close(true)
   end)
  end

  X.ActivePopup=nil
 end

 X.Connections[#X.Connections+1]=UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if not X.ActivePopup then
   return
  end

  if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
   X:CloseActivePopup()
   return
  end

  if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
   and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
   return
  end

  local active=X.ActivePopup
  local position=input.Position

  -- Keep it open when interacting with its own selector or popup.
  if pointInside(active._Selector,position)
   or pointInside(active._Menu,position) then
   return
  end

  -- Any click/tap elsewhere closes it, including the Roblox world.
  X:CloseActivePopup()
 end)

 -- PAGE SYSTEM ---------------------------------------------------------
 local navOrder=0
 function X:AddPage(name,opts)
  opts=opts or{};if X.Pages[name]then return X.Pages[name]end;navOrder+=1
  local page=New("ScrollingFrame",{Name=name,BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,ScrollBarThickness=3,ScrollBarImageTransparency=.3,Visible=false,ZIndex=14,Parent=ph});bind(page,"ScrollBarImageColor3","A2");New("UIPadding",{PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,3),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,6),Parent=page});New("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,5),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Parent=page})
  page:SetAttribute("AllowMultipleFeatures",opts.AllowMultipleFeatures==true)

  local tab=New("TextButton",{AutoButtonColor=false,BackgroundTransparency=.68,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40),LayoutOrder=navOrder,Text="",ZIndex=14,Parent=nav});bind(tab,"BackgroundColor3","Panel2");Round(tab,9);local ts=Stroke(tab,T.Stroke,.82);bind(ts,"Color","Stroke")

  local rail=New("Frame",{BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(3,26),ZIndex=15,Parent=tab});bind(rail,"BackgroundColor3","A1");Round(rail,999)

  local icon=New("ImageLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(20,20),Image=Icons[name] or Icons.Misc,ImageTransparency=.22,ZIndex=15,Parent=tab});bind(icon,"ImageColor3","Soft")

  local label=New("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(39,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-45,1,0),Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Text=name,TextSize=11,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,ZIndex=15,Parent=tab});bind(label,"TextColor3","Soft")

  tab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()X:SwitchPage(name)end)
  tab.MouseEnter:Connect(function()if X.CurrentPage~=name then Tw(tab,.1,{BackgroundTransparency=.48});Tw(icon,.1,{ImageTransparency=0})end end)
  tab.MouseLeave:Connect(function()if X.CurrentPage~=name then Tw(tab,.1,{BackgroundTransparency=.68});Tw(icon,.1,{ImageTransparency=.18})end end)

  X.Pages[name]=page
  X.Nav[name]={Tab=tab,Stroke=ts,Rail=rail,Icon=icon,Label=label}
  if not X.CurrentPage then X:SwitchPage(name)end
  return page
 end
 function X:SwitchPage(name)
  local page=X.Pages[name]if not page then return end
  X:CloseActivePopup()
  X.CurrentPage=name;ptitle.Text=name;X:SetConfig("LastPage",name)
  for n,p in pairs(X.Pages)do p.Visible=n==name end
  for n,d in pairs(X.Nav)do
   local active=n==name
   Tw(d.Tab,.12,{BackgroundTransparency=active and .18 or .68})
   Tw(d.Rail,.12,{BackgroundTransparency=active and 0 or 1})
   Tw(d.Icon,.12,{ImageTransparency=active and 0 or .18})
   d.Icon.ImageColor3=active and T.A2 or T.Soft
   d.Label.TextColor3=active and T.Text or T.Soft
